description: List contradictions: declared exclusive conflict keys; polarity pairs (the same title asserted both ways, kept side by side); verified facts retired in the last 14 days, each with what replaced it and whether that replacement is still active; and same-subject active pairs with a verified side, which the write path keeps side by side instead of letting either retire the other. Use when a write reports an overlapping item left active, or when memory gives contradictory answers. A wrong retirement is undone by storing the correct fact with supersedes naming its replacement; a side-by-side pair is resolved by retiring one with supersedes (or knowl_update), never by storing a third item. A write that reports a possible REVERSAL is telling you something this command does not list -- act on it there.
name: knowl_conflicts
